title: Prefabs: 90-second tour
description: Meet the entity list, the component editor, the live JSON, and the 3-D preview.

steps.hint: Prefabs are reusable entity templates — lights, actors, items, triggers. Let's walk through the four panels that make up the Prefabs view.
On the left, every entity in the active pack. Filter by category, click a row to make it the active prefab.
The component editor — add, remove, and tune the components attached to the active prefab.
Every edit reflects live in the JSON preview — this is exactly what the pack will ship.
And the 3-D preview — drag to orbit, scroll to zoom. The entity renders with its real components, lights, and materials.
